records.name: stitched_grass_top
records.prompt: Create one production game texture asset, not a mockup. A flat, seamless, tileable square diffuse texture for the TOP of a Minecraft-inspired 'Stitched Grass' terrain block in a supernatural handcrafted world. Orthographic top-down material only, filling the entire square edge to edge. Lush but restrained moss/grass green short woven fibers, with a subtle irregular network of tiny cream and muted dark-green hand stitches sewn into the turf. Crisp deliberately placed pixel-art clusters at the scale of a 64x64 texture; limited cohesive palette, high readability at small scale, soft baked ambient variation but no directional shadows. Seamless left-right and top-bottom edges. No border, frame, isolated objects, text, labels, perspective, cube preview, or transparency. Output a single square texture, preferably 512 by 512 pixels. This is original material artwork for a Coraline-inspired mod, not an image of a landscape.

records.edit_prompt: Correct this game foliage texture's alpha only. Keep the pale cream and sage folded paper leaves, their arrangement, tactile paper detail, colors and seamless square composition. REMOVE every checkerboard/background patch between the leaves. Those gaps must be completely transparent with alpha exactly zero, with no gray or white squares baked into RGB. Leaf interiors should be opaque alpha 255, not semi-transparent; only very thin antialiased leaf edges may be partial alpha. This is a cutout leaf block texture, no solid background, no drop shadows. Do not replace the leaves or add text, borders, cubes or scenery.
